messages.confirmSendCampaign: Are you sure you want to send this campaign? This will start sending messages to all targeted contacts.
messages.confirmAbortCampaign: Are you sure you want to abort this campaign? Messages already sent will not be recalled.
messages.confirmStopEnrollment: Stop enrolling new contacts into this campaign? Contacts already enrolled will still be processed, and the campaign will complete once they are done.
messages.abTestHint: The audience (Target Lists) is moved to a new Campaign Distribution and split between the original campaign and the variants by the percentages below. Percentages are rebalanced when variants are added or removed and must sum to 100.
messages.abTestCreatedActivationFailed: A/B test created, but activation failed: {error} Review the distribution and activate it manually.
messages.weightsMustSumTo100: Audience percentages must sum to 100 (current sum: {sum}).
messages.insertToken: Click to insert a field into the message:

tooltips.chatwootInbox: Select an active WhatsApp inbox. The Chat account and (for Meta channels) the credentials used to load templates and send are derived from that inbox's channel connection. QR Code inboxes can only send Free Text.
tooltips.templateName: Select the WhatsApp message template to use for this campaign. Templates are fetched from the Meta WhatsApp Business Account linked to the selected inbox.
tooltips.parameterMapping: Maps template parameters to contact fields. Define which contact data fills each placeholder in the template.
tooltips.processedParams: The resolved parameter values after processing the mapping against actual contact data.
tooltips.continuousEnrollment: When enabled, contacts added to the Target Lists or Manual Contacts after the campaign starts are automatically enrolled and messaged. The campaign stays in Sending status until you stop enrollment or abort it.
tooltips.createOpportunity: When enabled, a successful WhatsApp send creates or reuses an open Opportunity for the Contact in the configured funnel. Failed sends never create Opportunities.
tooltips.funnel: The funnel used to find an existing open Opportunity or create a new one after a successful send.
tooltips.opportunityStage: Required open stage for newly created Opportunities. Reused Opportunities keep their current stage.
tooltips.opportunityAssignedUser: Assigned user for newly created Opportunities. The user must belong to a funnel team.
tooltips.tenant: Denormalized tenant of the campaign's parent ChatwootAccount. Set automatically; used for per-tenant reports and ACL-free aggregations.
tooltips.messageMode: Meta Template sends an approved WhatsApp template and requires a Meta Cloud API or Coexistence inbox. Free Text sends a plain message and also works with QR Code (WAHA) inboxes; on Cloud API it only reaches contacts inside the 24h reply window.
tooltips.messageBody: The message sent to each contact. Supports Handlebars expressions resolved against the Contact, e.g. {{firstName}} or {{account.name}}.
tooltips.attachment: Optional media sent with the message. How WhatsApp renders it is derived from the file type: audio becomes a voice message, images and videos render inline, and anything else is sent as a document. The message body becomes the caption and may be left empty. Max 16 MB.
tooltips.sendAudioAsVoice: On (default): an audio file is delivered as a WhatsApp voice message (the microphone bubble). Off: it is delivered as a downloadable audio document instead. Has no effect on non-audio attachments.
